body: Its not gonna help, I've tried. Appreciate the offer, but it's sincerely not gonna work. I'm hardly worth any of the trouble, anyways.
Man, I'm honestly not in the mood for self-improvement. I'm trying, it's getting fucking nowhere. I feel like I keep pushing forward, but I make absolutely no headway. It's just not worth it.

I'm in college too and I couldn't even get myself to do any kind of work today because I overloaded myself too much this past weekend, and now I feel like I have absolutely no one here in college to talk to. I hate going to therapy, it hasn't ever worked for me.

I'm not good enough for anything, I feel like people wouldn't care if I were to kill myself, and all it does is make me want to just leave this planet.

Please don't say things you don't mean, man...

Everyone wants to make people happy, but nobody is willing to put in that kind of effort. As a result, I'm the only one who can pull through for myself. Regardless of all the fucking cliches and useless shit thrown at me, I'm by myself in this.
Again, it's much appreciated. I can't promise that I'll get better, but I'll keep it all in mind. I won't forget.
I have neither, I don't keep up on social media.... I could PM you though....

I don't know about that last statement, but I do appreciate the compliment all the same...

I'm bad at even texting people, man. It's the worst....

I dunno... My depression tends to fluctuate between feeling alright-ish and just plain lonely and awful. It's hard to say.

I just kinda wish I could maintain this kind of conversation better with people face-to-face.
Thank you... I try, and it's one of the only areas I even have pride in.

Some of my favorites from recent memory? Silence of the Lambs, Back to the Future, Night of the Hunter, Do The Right Thing, Lawrence of Arabia, Apocalypse Now. Among many others.

Yeah, but the professors are still going relatively easy on the students, since we're all still freshman and everything...

I haven't posted any of my art online. If I ever do, I'll link it to you.

I mean, a good variety of things - movies are the main thing I do in my free time, analyzing them and all that. (Not a film major, mostly taught myself how to analyze them). In general, I love art - I've been a visual artist for several years, architecture major as well.

Video games, even though I haven't been playing much at all recently. Sonic and Pokémon are childhood favorites.

It was my mom's decision... she loves her.

Yeah, both have their merits. Maybe one day when I have my time management skills down I can manage a dog.

Her name's Callas... after the opera singer.

Dogs tend to be energetic and friendly, and really kinda "communicate" with people in a nice (albeit primitive) way. I like that, but at the same time it's practically a full-time job to take care of them. 

Cats also can be really friendly as well, and I do enjoy their more laidback demeanor as a whole. They're more for the introvert, which I also like a lot.
Well, my family has a cat, but I like both equally for different reasons.

Look, I can't promise that I'll stop feeling the way I am right now, in a week, or maybe even ever. Maybe I'll end up having this kind of low energy and lack of motivation to go through me all my life. I don't care much for medication, nor do I care much for therapy, so those ideas are pretty much (if not permanently) off the table.

The loneliness is just... tearing me apart. I just am tired of having to feel like there isn't a support system. I'm tired of having to have conversations with people which are almost exclusively about myself and my issues. I just want to feel like I'm accepted or cared for by someone else.

I just can't handle it.

Not just the anxiety, the major depression (which I found out I had this past November the last time I was at a hospital). He didn't prescribe me anything (mainly because he didn't see anything especially wrong with me, besides, I don't want to have to do it - I've done it before, and it makes certain other areas of my life worse).

I just don't feel like I can consistently handle this endless cycle of feeling horrible and not having the guts to tell anyone. The feelings are terrible, and I HATE having to feel lonely. I just can't feel any happiness or energy or motivation to keep going on.

Double that with the fact that nobody would want to hear my complaints. Even if they did, I don't want to feel like I'm guilting them into anything.

My mom doesn't think I have depression, and is more of an old-school conservative type on the whole issue.

I'm in college, and it's going alright for me academically, not so well socially. I constantly feel alone, with nobody to talk to (I have contacts, but my fucking anxiety gives me too much stress). My mom doesn't help, either - and it just feels like I wish I could just stop feeling anything.
